setup.eval: (async () => { const code = [...document.querySelectorAll('code')].map(c => c.textContent.trim()).find(t => /^\d{6}$/.test(t)); const input = document.querySelector('input[name=code]'); input.value = code; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Verify').click(); })()
